title: elymus trachycaulus subsp. sierrae
intro: Elymus trachycaulus subsp. sierrae, commonly known as Sierra wildrye, is a perennial grass native to the Sierra Nevada mountain range in California. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to promote health and well-being. The health benefits of Elymus trachycaulus subsp. sierrae include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and support immune system function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
